margin_justification: Study-specific research tolerances for mean paired deterioration: 0.002 absolute IPCW IBS and 0.010 absolute cure-probability RMSE. The primary paper's quadratic-surface simulations report RBF GG-KM improvements over linear-kernel GG-KM of approximately 0.007-0.012 IBS and 0.04-0.07 cure RMSE (sections/06_discussion.tex, principal simulation results). The selected tolerances allow losing approximately 17-29% and 14-25% of those benchmark improvements, respectively, preserving at least approximately 71% of the IBS gain and 75% of the cure-RMSE gain over that reported range. A cure-RMSE increase of 0.010 is one percentage point on the probability-error scale, not a bound on every individual's prediction error. These benchmark gains motivate common absolute tolerances across the prespecified robustness cells; they do not assert the same gains in every cell. This is a research judgment informed by the paper and the already inspected exploratory misspecification study, fixed before the new independent pilot/final outcomes. The values were not selected to make every historical comparison pass and are not clinically validated or universal cutoffs.
